metadata.name: SageMaker training job failure
metadata.description: A SageMaker training job wrote an error to CloudWatch Logs.

query.base: FROM logs-aws_sagemaker.logs-* | WHERE aws_sagemaker.workload == "training" AND event.outcome == "failure" | STATS failures = COUNT(*) BY aws_sagemaker.job.name

data.content: Open the training job in the SageMaker console and read FailureReason in /aws/sagemaker/TrainingJobs. Check the training role can read the input data, then increase instance memory if the line is an out-of-memory error.
